summary_rationale: On a strictly price-blind business and forensic audit updated through November 20, 2026, TSMC retains its COMPOUNDER_PASS verdict. Over FY2016-FY2025, USD revenue compounded from $29.43B to $122.42B (+35.9% YoY) and accelerated to $46.72B in Q3 2026 (+41.2% YoY; 9M 2026 NT$3,898.7B), with October 2026 sales jumping +59.7% YoY to NT$586.89B. Pure-play neutrality, OIP lock-in, 15.0M annual 12-inch wafer scale, <=7nm mix at 79% (N3 33%, N2 8%), and non-wafer packaging/mask sales surging +112.8% YoY to 18.4% of Q3 revenue sustain an unmatched leading-edge moat. Financially, 9M 2026 CFO of NT$2,402.12B (117.6% of NI) yielded NT$1,112.15B (~$34.9B) in 9M FCF and lifted net cash to $93.64B ($126.0B cash and current securities vs. $32.36B debt) as of September 30, 2026, funding a 28.6% Q3 dividend hike to NT$9.0/share and $40.93B in November 2026 Board capex approvals. kpi_health remains PASS_WITH_WATCH to monitor: (1) $60B-$64B FY2026 capex and 2%-4% overseas fab GM drag, (2) customer/U.S. concentration (U.S. HQ 78.9% in Q3 2026; NVIDIA 19%, Apple 17%) plus $1.5B in newly approved Anthropic/OpenAI/VC equity allocations, (3) footnote cash-quality drivers (NT$359.48B refundable/offsettable customer temporary receipts, NT$167.59B 9M government grants lowering depreciation, and a NT$63.20B Q2 VIS remeasurement gain), and (4) Section 232/301 tariff, Nanjing annual export-license, and FX margin risks (-0.3 ppt operating margin per 1% USD/NTD drop).
